# Your calendar, overview and recovery tools

Live since24October2026: https://dainyelonthemove.com/admin#admin-content . Your usual Google and Authenticator sign-in remains required.

## Calendar

- Month calendar shows a social icon and time on each planned day. On wider screens it also shows the title/status; on phones select the icon to read everything.
- Previous/Next and This month navigate the plan. Dates/times use Europe/Amsterdam, including when your device is abroad. Filters show posts still to schedule, scheduled, published or needing attention.
- Select a post to open its full caption, photo, Canva design, music, time and checklist. Choose the intended social platforms, edit and Save changes. Scheduled/Published are manual checkmarks: they do not upload or schedule a social post.
- Post list keeps the earlier layout available. Closing an edited post asks before discarding unsaved writing. Another-device conflict asks you to preserve your text instead of overwriting silently.
- The test calendar has a separate copy of the existing live plan. Its edits stay on the test site. Reminder email is disabled for this isolated test calendar. Your existing live reminder preference was left unchanged.

## Overview

Choose Stories/Field Notes/facts, existing page sections, or Postcards. The overview checks the saved state and matching publication separately:

| Label | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Private draft | Saved, not published through this editor. |
| Original page content | No active override; visitors see the source page. |
| Published version matches | Saved writing matches the published version. |
| Saved changes are not published | Visitors still see an earlier version. |
| Status unavailable | Reconnect/Refresh before acting; no guessed state. |

Email delivery is separate. A saved Postcard is not a sent email. Campaigns created directly in Brevo must be checked there. The overview shows25 items at a time, with Older/Latest navigation, and excludes unsaved browser edits. Open & edit brings you to the right editor.

## Recover an earlier version

1. Open the story/page section/Postcard.
2. Expand Saved versions & automatic recovery; choose Load saved versions.
3. Select the version by date/number. Older versions is available after20 results.
4. It opens as unsaved edits with its saved photo references. Save, preview and explicitly publish if you want it back on the website. A restored Postcard never sends automatically or changes an existing campaign/request.

Every confirmed save keeps a version; the first save after this update also preserves the immediately preceding saved state. It cannot reconstruct versions overwritten before this feature existed. Uploaded photos stay available to old versions. Unconfirmed typing is not an automatic saved backup: keep the editor open or download it if your connection fails.

## Independent OneDrive recovery

The overview shows the last checksum-verified independent snapshot. Existing OneDrive project → backups → content contains dated private ZIP files. Keep them private.

Unzip the archive and open restore-in-admin:

- entries: use Write → Restore a downloaded backup. It opens a new private copy.
- website: open the matching page/section → Restore a section backup. It opens unsaved edits. A later technical template restructure may require a section migration.
- postcards: Postcards → Download or restore an editable email backup. Nothing sends/schedules.
- calendar: Import your content plan. New checklist flags begin unticked; review your actual social/Metricool plans before scheduling again. Raw documents preserve the original flags for technical disaster recovery.

Per-save recovery versions are active on staging. The separate OneDrive backup is checked after staging releases and can be requested from the existing GitHub workflow. Daily cloud scheduling is active after the approved24October main release; the first production snapshot was verified. No AI/local computer must stay running after that native schedule is released. Free quotas and OneDrive/Firebase/GitHub availability apply; no unlimited retention/storage guarantee.

## Production release — 24 October 2026

The owner approved the coordinated release. Production CMS, existing-page editing, Overview, recovery and the visual calendar are active. Production uses its existing calendar records/checkmarks, not the staging copy. The normal live publication/withdrawal and original-section restore were verified, and no verification content remains public.

Daily OneDrive scheduling is now present on the live default branch, and a real production snapshot completed with checksum readback. Per-save private versions work independently of AI. The earlier staging instructions above describe the isolated review environment; use the live admin for real content. No subscriber email was sent. Marketing sending and contact forwarding remain off; contact messages arrive in the private website inbox. Read-only public Postcard archiving is active after the24hour delay.
